_comment: T-03 gravity sweep — 3× nominal | M3 × abrupt × 5 seeds × 1M steps
_purpose: Characterise detection envelope at 3× gravity (g=-29.43 m/s²). Part of T-03 gravity boundary sweep. See planned_tests.md T-03 and tuning_journal.md T-03.
_parameters: floor=2e-4 (instrument.json), m_fail=2 (instrument.json) — both locked by T-01/T-02.
_why_3x: If 2× is still below the Pr(timely)≥0.60 knee, 3× is the upper bound. If 3× also fails, the framework has a sensitivity limitation at 1M steps — this becomes a thesis finding, not a parameter to tune.
